L01_female.wav.speaker: female
L01_female.wav.text: Good morning! Welcome to Sunbeam Coffee. What can I get started for you?

L02_male.wav.speaker: male
L02_male.wav.text: Hi. I'd like a medium latte with oat milk, please.

L03_female.wav.speaker: female
L03_female.wav.text: Sure. Would you like whipped cream on that?

L04_male.wav.speaker: male
L04_male.wav.text: No, thanks. Just the latte is fine.

L05_female.wav.speaker: female
L05_female.wav.text: Anything to eat? Our blueberry muffin is fresh out of the oven.

L06_male.wav.speaker: male
L06_male.wav.text: That sounds great. I'll take one muffin too.

L07_female.wav.speaker: female
L07_female.wav.text: Perfect. That comes to nine fifty. Can I get your name?

L09_female.wav.speaker: female
L09_female.wav.text: Thanks, Ken. We'll call your name at the counter in a few minutes.
